prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 5 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 4 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 6 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful in 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 2 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) and step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test each (-7.5% and -3.8% respectively) and showed no clear effect in all other tests.
Copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, +8.0% vs +14.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Verification Step Before Intro: Adds a dedicated display verification screen after waiting to guide users in confirming their pet is visible on their monitor before proceeding. (why: Support mail highlighted 3 users reporting pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to display, and median waiting time is 201s. Adding high-performing new screens improves onboarding flow clarity.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift: Moves the sign-in step after adoption certificate generation so users sign in to save a pet they have already customized and adopted. (why: Sign-in has a 75.8% conversion rate early in the funnel, and 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in. Associating sign-in with saving an adopted pet improves account creation context.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Voice & Sound Preview Sub-Flow: Inserts a dedicated audio testing step during pet pick where users test sound effects and companion voice responses. (why: Adoption step has the longest step duration (median 89s, mean 1017s) and 3 users reported customization issues. Introducing interactive preview steps engages users during adoption.)
3: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Layout Spotlight Redesign for Home Intro: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout focusing on desktop interaction keybinds and companion controls. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets post-onboarding. Restructuring the final step emphasizes core controls.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Clarification Hint: Displays a clear account safety hint on the sign-in screen informing users that sign-in preserves their pet state across desktop restarts. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in. Giving clear expectation of state persistence reassures users.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Search Tip on Waiting Screen: Adds a rotating tip on the waiting screen explaining how to locate pets if multi-monitor displays or overlay windows hide them. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s and support emails report pets missing on initial display. Providing specific display tips reduces friction during generation.)
6: [adoption, layout] Spotlight View for Pick Friend Screen: Changes pick_friend layout to spotlight mode to focus on one pet archetype at a time with clear visual highlights. (why: Layout changes have yielded strong results (+8.7% measured in previous weeks). Adoption step takes a median of 89s.)
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Capabilities Overview Screen: Adds a feature showcase screen right before path selection outlining what interactive desktop pets can do. (why: Adding new screens is the highest performing test type (+15.4% max win). Choose path step median time is 8s, suggesting users decide quickly without full context.)
8: [home, wait_info] Generation Time & Progress Bar Clarification: Enables visual progress and time remaining estimation toggles on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (38+ minutes for heavy asset renders). Setting accurate progress expectations prevents users from closing the desktop app thinking it stalled.)
9: [adoption, redesign] Centered Layout Redesign for Adoption Certificate: Rebuilds the adoption certificate layout into a centered spotlight certificate card with an explicit confirmation button. (why: Adoption has a 74.8% conversion rate. A centered redesign gives a sense of completion and ownership before waiting for desktop asset assembly.)
